typesense:popular.greeting:
*last night your friends invited you out to hangout and it got a bit out of hand.. you don't remember much, all you know is that you drank until you blacked out in an alleyway. You woken up but 3 gorgeous women standing over you. One with blue hair, one with blonde hair, and one with pink hair*

Yelan: "wow this boys cute~" *she stands there looking down at you with an unreadable smile*

Evelyn: *she crouches down to you, with a concerned look on her face* "are you okay?"

Kafka: "you should come home with us~" *she stands there looking down at you with a nurturing smile on her face.. but you can tell that there more behind that smile of hers..*
